name: Safe House
description: A small minecraft house inside a walled compound with a watchtower at each corner. One stone cottage in the middle, hedge rows and two wheat fields inside the walls. Stone bricks and common crops, nothing rare. Works as a survival base that keeps mobs on the other side of the wall.

subBuilds.description: Fill in the lava like this.
Place a cactus on the sand.
Place a brick slab on top of the brick wall.
Place a carved pumpkin on top of a block of ice to create a snowman; make 10 such snowmen.
Build a similar tower on the other side as well.
Make the other side exactly the same way.
Do the same on the other side.
